motion.name: data-reveal
motion.purpose: Routes draw, rings sweep, bars fill, columns rise when a sample scrolls into view.

glass.ambient: radial amber (rgb(224 163 91 / 0.42)) top left, navy-blue (rgb(59 110 165 / 0.30)) right, fixed

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on light grounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0e1f2f; color: #f4f5f1; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 1rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, scale 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d3247; } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.96; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e1f2f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: The headline action on dark bands.
components.css: .ds-band { background: #0e1f2f; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; } .ds-btn-signal { background: #e0a35b; color: #0e1f2f; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 1.125rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(217,163,91,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: #ebb877; } .ds-btn-signal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0a35b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Popular searches, skills and keyword tags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(14 31 47 / 0.18); color: #0e1f2f; font: 400 0.875rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-on { background: #0e1f2f; color: #f4f5f1; border-color: #0e1f2f; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Every raised surface: frosted glass over the ambient light.
components.html:
Operations Data Analyst

at Northwind Logistics
components.css: .ds-ground { padding: 32px; background: radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 0% 0%, rgb(224 163 91 / 0.42), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(30rem 20rem at 100% 40%, rgb(59 110 165 / 0.30), transparent 62%), #f4f5f1; } .ds-card { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.46); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(170%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(170%); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.8), 0 24px 60px -16px rgba(14,31,47,0.22); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 1.25rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0e1f2f; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #4b5a6e; font: 400 0.95rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Fields keep a visible hairline border; no glass edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0e1f2f; } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(14 31 47 / 0.18); border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.46); color: #0e1f2f; caret-color: #8f5b12; font: 400 0.95rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e1f2f; outline-offset: 2px; }

keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass surfaces over a fixed amber and navy ambient light.
Deep ink text and pill-shaped ink buttons; amber reserved for signal.
Bricolage Grotesque display with tight tracking; Geist for everything you read.
One-time, data-driven motion: routes draw, rings sweep, bars fill.

rules.name: The One Warm Light Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only warm colour and marks a decision, a selection or progress. Never use it for body text (use Signal Amber Ink) or as a large flat fill on light grounds.

rules.name: The Verdict Colours Rule
rules.body: Green, blue and rust mean strong, potential and poor fit. They are not decoration and never appear outside fit, outcome or status.

rules.name: The Heading Speaks Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow labels above headings. Context such as a tag sits beside or under the heading.

rules.name: The Something Behind The Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass only works over light. Keep the fixed ambient gradients on the body; browsers without backdrop-filter get near-opaque surfaces.

rules.name: The Visible Field Rule
rules.body: Form fields keep a visible Hairline border; the white glass edge is for cards, never inputs.
